fields.detail: The refuter named the single open danger that would falsify rung R-delta3-n16-three-targets: a non-regular min-degree-3 2-connected girth-6 graph on 15 or 16 vertices with no 8-cycle. A minimal counterexample is 2-connected, so verifying every 2-connected min-degree>=3 graph on n<=16 has a 4/8/16-cycle reduces to: n<=8 girth<=4 (C4, closed), girth-5 n>=10 (closed to n=13, extend 14-16), girth-6 n=14..16 (NEW, seed C6). This gives the run's own independent machine check of the n<=16 baseline that currently rides on Balaji's uncertified preprint.
